name: Companies Compliance Facilitation Scheme 2026
feeBenefit: Only 10% of applicable additional fee payable for eligible overdue filings
eligibilityCriteria: Company must be registered under Companies Act 2013 or previous Companies Act 1956
Filings must be overdue as on scheme commencement date (15 April 2026)
Company must not be under liquidation, strike-off, or dissolution proceedings
All pending filings must be completed within the scheme period
Professional certification required where mandated by respective forms
excludedEntities: Companies under CIRP (Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process)
Companies with pending prosecution under Companies Act
